examples.en: We are on the same team.
Our football team won the game.
examples.zh: 我们的足球队赢了比赛。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：team 音近「替姆」，同一 team 里大家互相替着上。
语义联想：We are on the same team. team 是队、组、班。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 teams

examples.en: He is a good basketball player.
examples.zh: 他是一名优秀的篮球运动员。

examples.en: Every player on the team works hard.
examples.zh: 队里每个队员都很努力。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：play 玩/打 + er 的人，player 是运动员、选手。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 players

examples.en: I often play chess with him.
Give the ball to him, please.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Give the ball to him. him 是他（宾格）。

examples.en: She has a lovely smile.
What a lovely day for sports!
examples.zh: 多么适合运动的好天气啊！

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She has a lovely smile. lovely 是美丽的、可爱的。

examples.en: My friend is very clever.
The clever robot can jump.
examples.zh: 这个聪明的机器人会跳。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My friend is very clever. clever 是聪明的。

examples.en: He is young but hard-working.
The young player loves basketball.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的队员热爱篮球。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He is young but hard-working. young 是年轻的。

examples.en: She is a hard-working student.
Hard-working people finish their work on time.
examples.zh: 勤奋的人会按时完成任务。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：hard 努力 + working 工作，hard-working 是勤奋的。

examples.en: The robot can jump and play chess.
examples.zh: 这个机器人会跳也会下棋。

examples.en: I want to make a robot for our project.
examples.zh: 我想为我们的项目做一个机器人。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 robot 机器人会跳、会下棋。

examples.en: Can you jump rope?
The player can jump very high.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 jump 跳起来越过绳子。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 jumps；过去式 jumped

examples.en: She jumps rope every morning.
This rope is too short for me.
examples.zh: 这条绳子对我来说太短了。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 rope 绳子用来跳绳。

examples.en: She plays the piano very well.
I have piano lessons on Saturday.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：piano 音近「皮阿诺」，钢琴的经典叫法。
语义联想：piano 表示「钢琴」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: Let's play chess after school.
He is good at chess.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 chess 棋盘上的黑白棋子。

examples.en: Please sit in the front row.
The star stands in front of the team.
examples.zh: 明星队员站在队伍前面。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Sit in the front row. front 是前面、正面。

examples.en: This chess game is easy for him.
examples.zh: 这盘棋对他来说很简单。

examples.en: It's easy to jump rope if you practice.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This game is easy. easy 是容易的、简单的。

examples.en: He is the star of our team.
examples.zh: 他是我们队的明星队员。

examples.en: The young star plays the piano well.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的明星钢琴弹得很好。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：star 音近「斯达」，明星 star 很「斯达」。
语义联想：star 表示「明星」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: We had a wonderful time at sports day.
examples.zh: 我们在运动会上玩得很开心。

examples.en: What a wonderful team!

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：wonder 惊奇 + ful，wonderful 是极好的、精彩的。

examples.en: My pen pal is from Australia.
examples.zh: 我的笔友来自澳大利亚。

examples.en: Australia is a beautiful country.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚是一个美丽的国家。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Australia 澳大利亚有袋鼠和考拉。

examples.en: What's the matter? You look worried.
examples.zh: 怎么了？你看起来很担心。

examples.en: It doesn't matter. We can try again.
examples.zh: 没关系，我们可以再试一次。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What's the matter? matter 是问题、麻烦；要紧。

examples.en: We have a science project this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们有一个科学项目。

examples.en: Let's finish the project together.
examples.zh: 我们一起完成这个项目吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have a science project. project 是项目、方案。

examples.en: Meet me at the sports centre.
The library is in the city centre.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Meet me at the sports centre. centre 是中心。

examples.en: I agree with you.
We all agree on the plan.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I agree with you. agree 是同意、赞成。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 agrees；过去式 agreed

examples.en: Please finish your homework first.
We must finish the project today.
examples.zh: 我们今天必须完成这个项目。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Please finish your homework. finish 是完成、结束。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 finishes；过去式 finished

examples.en: Don't be worried. Everything is fine.
My parent looks worried about the test.
examples.zh: 我父母看起来很担心考试。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't be worried. worried 是担心的、发愁的。

examples.en: Both of my parents are teachers.
I like both maths and English.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Both of my parents are teachers. both 是两个都、两者都。

examples.en: We are excited about the school trip.
examples.zh: 我们对学校旅行很兴奋。

examples.en: She feels excited before the game.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We are excited about the trip. excited 是兴奋的、激动的。

examples.en: Something is wrong with my phone.
I'm afraid your answer is wrong.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Your answer is wrong. wrong 是错误的、有毛病。

examples.en: Don't be afraid. I'll help you.
She is afraid of the dark.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't be afraid. afraid 是害怕、担心。

examples.en: My parent will come to the meeting.
Every parent cares about their child.
examples.zh: 每位家长都关心自己的孩子。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：par 生 + ent，parent 是父母、家长。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 parents

examples.en: Ask your teacher if you don't understand.
Can I ask you a question?
examples.zh: 我可以问你一个问题吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Ask your teacher a question. ask 是问、询问。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 asks；过去式 asked

examples.en: Please don't move the desk.
We will move to a new classroom.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Please don't move the desk. move 是移动、搬动。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 moves；过去式 moved

examples.en: What's your favourite subject?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

examples.en: English is my favourite subject.
examples.zh: 英语是我最喜欢的科目。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sub 下 + ject 投，subject 是科目、学科。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 subjects

examples.en: We have English on Tuesday.
Tuesday is my busiest day.
examples.zh: 星期二是我最忙的一天。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have English on Tuesday. Tuesday 是星期二。

examples.en: I like PE because it's fun.
examples.zh: 我喜欢体育课，因为它很有趣。

examples.en: She stays at home because she is ill.
examples.zh: 她待在家里，因为她生病了。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：be 因为 + cause 原因，because 是因为。

examples.en: We start school at eight o'clock.
Let's start the lesson now.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：School starts at eight. start 是开始、着手。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 starts；过去式 started

examples.en: I usually get up at seven.
We usually have lunch at school.
examples.zh: 我们通常在学校吃午饭。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：usual 通常 + ly，usually 是通常、平常。

examples.en: I visit my grandparents at the weekend.
What do you do on the weekend?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：week 周 + end 末，weekend 是周末。

examples.en: I sometimes play ping-pong on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我有时星期六打乒乓球。

examples.en: Sometimes we have art lessons at night.
examples.zh: 有时我们晚上上美术课。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：some 有些 + times 次，sometimes 是有时候。

examples.en: I have a piano lesson on Saturday.
Saturday is my favourite day.
examples.zh: 星期六是我最喜欢的一天。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I have piano on Saturday. Saturday 是星期六。

examples.en: We have an English lesson today.
examples.zh: 我们今天有一节英语课。

examples.en: The lesson starts at nine o'clock.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We have an English lesson. lesson 是课、一节课。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 lessons

examples.en: Please answer the question.
I know the answer to this problem.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Please answer the question. answer 是回答、答案。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 answers；过去式 answered

examples.en: I play ping-pong after school.
Ping-pong is my favourite sport.
examples.zh: 乒乓球是我最喜欢的运动。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ping pong 是球来回弹的声音，ping-pong 是乒乓球。

examples.en: I do my homework at night.
Good night, Mum and Dad.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 night 夜晚天空挂着月亮和星星。

examples.en: I visit my grandparents every weekend.
examples.zh: 我每个周末去看望祖父母。

examples.en: We will visit the museum on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我们星期二去参观博物馆。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I visit my grandparents. visit 是拜访、参观。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 visits；过去式 visited

definitions.text: 祖父;祖母;外祖父;外祖母

examples.en: My grandparent lives in the countryside.
I love my grandparent very much.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：grand 祖辈 + parent 父母，grandparent 是祖父母。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 grandparents

examples.en: You should stay at home and rest.
Stay healthy and brush your teeth twice a day.
examples.zh: 保持健康，每天刷两次牙。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Stay at home and rest. stay 是停留、待。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 stays；过去式 stayed

examples.en: You should check your homework.
We should get enough sleep every night.
examples.zh: 我们每晚应该有足够的睡眠。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You should brush your teeth. should 是应该（提出建议）。

examples.en: What else do you do before bed?
Is there anything else I should know?
examples.zh: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What else do you do? else 是另外、其他。

examples.en: Did you get enough rest last night?
Drink enough water every day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：en 使 + ough 足够，enough 是足够的。

examples.en: If you are tired, you should rest.
examples.zh: 如果你累了，就应该休息。

examples.en: Call me if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果需要帮助就给我打电话。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：If you are tired, rest. if 是如果、假如。

examples.en: Brushing teeth twice a day is a good habit.
examples.zh: 每天刷两次牙是个好习惯。

examples.en: Reading before bed is my habit.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Brushing teeth is a good habit. habit 是习惯。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 habits

examples.en: I watch a TV show after dinner.
examples.zh: 我晚饭后看一个电视节目。

examples.en: My favourite show is on at seven.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的节目七点播出。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：show 音近「秀」，TV show 就是电视节目。
语义联想：show 表示「节目」，结合本课例句记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 shows；过去式 showed

examples.en: Don't use your phone too late at night.
I'll phone you after school.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 phone 手机拿在手里打电话。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 phones；过去式 phoned

examples.en: Brush your teeth, then go to bed.
First rest, then check your bag.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Brush your teeth, then go to bed. then 是然后、那么。

examples.en: You need enough rest every day.
examples.zh: 你每天都需要有足够的休息。

examples.en: Let's rest for ten minutes.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You need enough rest. rest 是休息、剩余。

examples.en: Check your homework before class.
I check my bag every morning.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Check your homework. check 是检查、核对。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 checks；过去式 checked

definitions.text: (与不可数名词连用)较少的，更少的

examples.en: You should eat less candy.
Spend less time on your phone at night.
examples.zh: 晚上少花点时间玩手机。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Eat less candy. less 是更少、较少。

examples.en: Brush your teeth twice a day.
I brush my teeth before bed.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 brush 牙刷在 tooth 牙齿上刷。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 brushes；过去式 brushed

examples.en: Brush every tooth carefully.
A healthy tooth is white and clean.
examples.zh: 健康的牙齿又白又干净。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 tooth 牙齿洁白整齐。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 teeth

examples.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
We have PE twice a week.
examples.zh: 我们每周上两次体育课。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Brush teeth twice a day. twice 是两次、两遍。

examples.en: I rest for one hour after lunch.
The TV show is one hour long.
examples.zh: 这个电视节目有一小时长。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Rest for one hour. hour 是小时。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 hours

examples.en: I'm hungry. Let's have lunch.
Don't go to bed hungry.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I'm hungry. Let's eat. hungry 是饥饿的。

examples.en: I'd like some beef for dinner.
Beef and vegetables are good for you.
examples.zh: 牛肉和蔬菜对你有好处。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：beef 音近「比夫」，比夫常联想成牛肉。
语义联想：beef 表示「牛肉」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: I'd like an ice cream, please.
Ice cream is cold and sweet.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ice 冰 + cream 奶油，ice cream 是冰淇淋。

examples.en: Would you like some tea?
My grandparent drinks tea every morning.
examples.zh: 我祖父母每天早上喝茶。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：tea 就是「茶」，发音与中文「茶」相近。
语义联想：tea 表示「茶叶;茶;茶水」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: I'd like a hamburger and some tea.
examples.zh: 我想要一个汉堡和一些茶。

examples.en: This hamburger is very big.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：ham 火腿 + burger 堡，hamburger 是汉堡包。

examples.en: Mrs Wang is our English teacher.
examples.zh: 王老师是我们的英语老师。

examples.en: Say hello to Mrs Li, please.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：Mrs 音近「密斯」，对已婚女士的称呼。
语义联想：Mrs 表示「夫人」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: The coconut is hard on the outside.
We drink coconut milk in summer.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：coconut 里 coco 音近「可可」，椰子可做成可可味饮品。
语义联想：coconut 表示「椰子」，结合本课例句记忆。

examples.en: Plant the seed in the soil.
A small seed can grow into a big tree.
examples.zh: 一颗小种子能长成大树。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 seed 种子埋进土里发芽。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 seeds

examples.en: Pull the stem gently.
Don't pull the flowers in the garden.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Pull the stem gently. pull 是拉、拽。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 pulls；过去式 pulled

examples.en: The stem holds up the flower.
Look at the green stem of the lotus.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 stem 茎把花和叶子撑起来。

examples.en: The root is under the ground.
The root helps the plant get water.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 root 根深深扎在地下吸水。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 roots

examples.en: The lotus grows in the lake.
Lotus flowers are pink and beautiful.
examples.zh: 荷花是粉红色的，很漂亮。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 lotus 荷花在 lake 湖里开放。

examples.en: We row a boat on the lake.
The lake is calm and beautiful.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 lake 湖面平静映着蓝天。

examples.en: There are many different plants in the world.
examples.zh: 世界上有许多不同的植物。

examples.en: I want to travel around the world.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Plants around the world. world 是世界。

examples.en: These two flowers are different.
We learn in different ways.
examples.zh: 我们用不同的方式学习。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：differ 不同 + ent，different 是不同的。

examples.en: This is a good way to learn words.
Show me the way to the lake, please.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This is a good way to learn. way 是方法、道路。

examples.en: The river runs through the forest.
We had a picnic by the river.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 river 河水从 mountain 山间流过。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 rivers

examples.en: I love nature and fresh air.
examples.zh: 我热爱大自然和新鲜空气。

examples.en: We learn about nature on our trip.
examples.zh: 我们在旅行中学习自然知识。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I love nature. nature 是自然、自然界。

examples.en: The forest is full of tall trees.
Don't start a fire in the forest.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 forest 森林里树木高大茂密。

examples.en: This mountain is very famous.
We visit a famous lake on our trip.
examples.zh: 我们在旅行中参观了一个著名的湖。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This mountain is famous. famous 是著名的。

examples.en: The mountain is high and dangerous.
We can see snow on the mountain.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 mountain 高山直插云端。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 mountains

examples.en: The wind is strong today.
Close the umbrella when the wind blows.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 wind 风吹动 umbrella 和 raincoat。

definitions.text: 〈尤指短程往返的)旅行，旅游，出行

examples.en: We are excited about the school trip.
examples.zh: 我们对学校旅行很兴奋。

examples.en: Our trip to the forest was wonderful.
examples.zh: 我们的森林之旅棒极了。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We are excited about the trip. trip 是旅行、出行。

examples.en: Swimming in the river is dangerous.
Fog makes driving dangerous.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Swimming here is dangerous. dangerous 是危险的。

examples.en: There will be heavy rain tomorrow.
The bag is too heavy for me.
examples.zh: 这个包对我来说太重了。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There will be heavy rain. heavy 是大的、严重的（程度）。

examples.en: We stay at a hotel near the lake.
examples.zh: 我们住在湖边的一家旅馆。

examples.en: The hotel is close to the mountain.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 hotel 旅馆里旅客休息过夜。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 hotels

examples.en: Please close the door.
The shop close to our hotel is open.
examples.zh: 我们旅馆附近的商店开着。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Please close the door. close 是关闭、关上。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 closes；过去式 closed

examples.en: Take an umbrella. It might rain.
My umbrella is blue.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：um 音 + brella 音，umbrella 是挡雨遮阳的伞。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 umbrellas

examples.en: Wear your raincoat in the rain.
I forgot my raincoat on the trip.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：rain 雨 + coat 外套，raincoat 是雨衣。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 raincoats

examples.en: Don't worry. The trip will be fine.
I worry about the heavy rain.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't worry. worry 是担心、担忧。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 worries；过去式 worried

examples.en: It's a fine day for a trip.
examples.zh: 今天天气晴朗，适合旅行。

examples.en: Everything will be fine.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It's a fine day. fine 是晴朗的；也可表示「好的」。

examples.en: There is thick fog this morning.
Fog makes it hard to see the road.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fog 大雾里看不清前面的路。

examples.en: Heavy rain can cause a flood.
The flood damaged the road.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 flood 洪水淹没了道路。

examples.en: Don't play with fire in the forest.
We must be careful with fire.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fire 火焰在 forest 里必须小心防范。

examples.en: I know this place. It's near the river.
examples.zh: 我认识这地方，在河边附近。

examples.en: Do you know the way to the hotel?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I know the way. know 是知道、了解。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 knows；过去式 knew

examples.en: Wash your hands before dinner.
Check the weather before the trip.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：be 在 + fore 前面，before 是在…之前。

examples.en: Bring your raincoat and umbrella.
Don't forget to bring enough water.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Bring your raincoat. bring 是带来、拿来。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 brings；过去式 brought
